acceptance_optimization: All categories are eligible; safety and recovery are optional. Prioritize the PDF and manufacturer-grounded ordinary tasks.
Preserve defining work: no captive substitute for a removed part, artificial support, missing insertion resistance, or softened thread/force solely to make success possible.
Use importance evidence about the exact operation; manuals establish existence, workforce totals do not establish task prevalence.
Use observable final-state scoring; penalize history only for irreversible damage or a stated real hazard.
Pass source/scale/reachability, novelty, two fresh full-score demos, negative controls, visual review, package/media checks before submission.
Submit validated unheld candidates immediately through shared submit.sh; revisions through revise.sh only after eligible feedback.
Do not overwrite Claude task folders or spend GPU time duplicating active builders.
